snippet.title: Dead Impact: Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to Dead Impact - new action MMORPG and zombie survival game!

Step into the post-apocalyptic world of this multiplayer survival game, where the only way to survive is through bravery and cooperation with friends. Experience all the hardships of life after the zombie apocalypse that wiped out most of the civilization. But hope still remains – the last survivors, scattered in fading cities, finding the last shelter in these evil lands as they form teams for mutual protection against their relentless enemies. Embark on an exhilarating co-op multiplayer survival adventure with your friends and try to survive Doomsday despite the odds.
